This post is my submission for DEV Education Track: Build Apps with Google AI Studio. I built an application that lets users generate a complete, custom coloring book from scratch. Key features allow users to enter a book title, provide multiple themes like "magic" or "animals," and select an age group to ensure the AI creates a whole book with perfectly suited drawings.
